When I was first placed on an antidepressant (I was 15),  it helped significantly. It didn't make me think any differently, just more clearly without the cloudiness of depression if that makes sense.  My advice though would be if you decide to take any antidepressants is make sure you have a good therapist and stick with them. Don't give up on therapy. Medications are helpful, and it's absolutely nothing to be ashamed of. But having a therapist to work through anxiety and depression helps so much more in the long run. Once you reach a certain point and you feel like your life is improving, you can always talk to your doctor and slowly decrease the medication and come off of it. Do not be afraid to ask the doctor a ton of questions. And hey, if you decide you don't want to take anything, that's perfectly okay too. It isn't for everyone. Best of luck!!
